update.name: Phoca Cart
update.description:
## Phoca Cart — Community-Driven E-Commerce for Joomla CMS
Phoca Cart is a powerful, fully-featured e-commerce solution built natively for Joomla. This repository represents the purely open-source, community-maintained core of the project.
**Important FOSS Declaration:** This project is developed, distributed, and maintained as non-commercial Free and Open Source Software (FOSS). It is run entirely by volunteer independent contributors and community enthusiasts.
### Why Phoca Cart is True Open Source: * **No Commercial Backing:** This repository is not operated by a commercial entity, nor is it part of a paid corporate product line. * **Volunteer Maintenance:** Bug fixes, feature implementations, and security patches are provided on a voluntary basis by the global Joomla community. * **Zero Monetization Here:** Access to this source code, its forks, and its releases via GitHub is completely free of charge and always will be. * **GNU GPL Licensed:** Distributed under the GNU General Public License. You have the total freedom to use, modify, and redistribute the code.
